observed_failure.result: RED: an attacker-selected candidate different from the root-approved candidate created the exclusive marker and returned RESERVED; the expected root-approved rejection was not raised.

preregistered_fix_scope: Install one root-owned exact approval record containing the owner-installed candidate commit and script-81 controller/scorer hash. The passwordless helper exposes that record read-only and permits marker creation only for its candidate. The controller exact-compares its executing bytes with the root-approved hash before requesting reservation. Do not modify frozen corpus, scorer algorithms, probe, CV, precision, model, engine, two-control, cost, or completed-result behavior.
acceptance: An unrelated clean user-owned commit is rejected before marker creation.
A descendant evidence commit not installed by root cannot become authority merely by being HEAD.
Repository-directory replacement and changed script-81 bytes are rejected before held-out open.
The exact root-installed candidate plus exact controller bytes may reserve once; retries fail closed.
Existing marker lookup remains fail-closed even after user repository HEAD advances.
No production reservation or held-out value is opened during implementation or testing.
